careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.description: Builds software that helps people and organizations solve practical problems.
careers.educationPathway: Computer science, IT, or portfolio-led routes with practical projects; requirements vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Turns ideas into apps and reliable digital tools.

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.description: Uses statistics and computing to investigate questions and explain useful findings.
careers.educationPathway: Computer science, IT, or portfolio-led routes with practical projects; requirements vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Finds patterns in data and explains what they might mean.

careers.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protects digital systems by spotting weaknesses and investigating unusual activity.
careers.educationPathway: Computer science, IT, or portfolio-led routes with practical projects; requirements vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Investigates how a system could be misused and helps make it safer.

careers.name: UX Designer
careers.description: Researches how people use products and designs clear, useful digital experiences.
careers.educationPathway: Design education or portfolio-led practice with projects and feedback.
careers.typicalActivities: Talks with users, sketches options, and tests whether an interface makes sense.

careers.name: AI Researcher
careers.description: Investigates ways computer systems can learn, reason, or assist with complex tasks.
careers.educationPathway: Strong mathematics and computing foundations; research roles may need advanced study.
careers.typicalActivities: Tests model behavior and looks for better, more reliable approaches.

careers.name: Robotics Engineer
careers.description: Designs, programs, or tests machines that sense and act in the physical world.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant engineering education or an accredited technical route, with practical projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Combines hardware and software to help machines perform useful tasks.

careers.name: Mechanical Engineer
careers.description: Develops and improves machines, products, vehicles, and energy systems.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant engineering education or an accredited technical route, with practical projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Models and tests parts to learn how they behave in real conditions.

careers.name: Civil Engineer
careers.description: Plans and helps build infrastructure such as bridges, transport, and water systems.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant engineering education or an accredited technical route, with practical projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Balances design, materials, safety, and community needs.

careers.name: Electrical Engineer
careers.description: Designs and tests electrical systems, electronics, and connected devices.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant engineering education or an accredited technical route, with practical projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds a circuit and investigates how it behaves.

careers.name: Environmental Engineer
careers.description: Applies engineering to clean water, pollution, and waste challenges.
careers.educationPathway: Environmental science, geography, or engineering study with field or data experience.
careers.typicalActivities: Uses measurements and design to reduce environmental harm.

careers.name: Biomedical Engineer
careers.description: Creates or improves devices, materials, and systems used in health care.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant engineering education or an accredited technical route, with practical projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Tests whether a device meets needs of patients and care teams.

careers.name: Operations Research Analyst
careers.description: Uses mathematics and models to help organizations make complex decisions.
careers.educationPathway: Business, economics, analytics, or a related field paired with applied projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Models options such as routes or schedules under constraints.

careers.name: Architect
careers.description: Plans spaces and buildings around how people use them, safety, materials, and place.
careers.educationPathway: Design education or portfolio-led practice with projects and feedback.
careers.typicalActivities: Turns a brief into a spatial design and revises it around real needs.

careers.name: Urban Planner
careers.description: Helps communities consider how land, transport, housing, and public spaces might develop.
careers.educationPathway: Public policy, law, language, technical, or subject study; national entry routes vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies a place and listens to residents before exploring possible changes.

careers.name: Renewable Energy Technician
careers.description: Installs, checks, and maintains solar, wind, and other energy equipment.
careers.educationPathway: Vocational training or apprenticeship with local safety and licensing requirements.
careers.typicalActivities: Checks equipment on site and traces faults safely.

careers.name: Physicist
careers.description: Investigates matter and energy through theory, experiments, or applied work.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant science education and lab or field experience; research roles may need further study.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds a model or experiment to test a question about nature.

careers.name: Chemist
careers.description: Studies substances and reactions for research, manufacturing, health, or safety.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant science education and lab or field experience; research roles may need further study.
careers.typicalActivities: Runs a controlled experiment and records how materials change.

careers.name: Biologist
careers.description: Studies living things and ecosystems, from cells to larger habitats.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant science education and lab or field experience; research roles may need further study.
careers.typicalActivities: Looks for patterns in how organisms grow and interact.

careers.name: Geospatial Scientist
careers.description: Uses maps, satellite images, and location data to understand how places change.
careers.educationPathway: Environmental science, geography, or engineering study with field or data experience.
careers.typicalActivities: Compares maps over time to find where landscapes are changing.

careers.name: Climate Scientist
careers.description: Studies climate systems and communicates evidence about past and possible changes.
careers.educationPathway: Environmental science, geography, or engineering study with field or data experience.
careers.typicalActivities: Uses observations and models to investigate environmental change.

careers.name: Physician
careers.description: Assesses health concerns, discusses options, and coordinates diagnosis or treatment.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Combines medical study with supervised clinical training.

careers.name: Registered Nurse
careers.description: Supports people through care by assessing needs and coordinating with a team.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Completes approved nursing education and local registration requirements.

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.description: Helps people improve movement through assessment and guided practice.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies physiotherapy and completes supervised clinical practice.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.description: Uses medicine knowledge to support safe use and answer people's questions.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies pharmacy and meets local registration requirements.

careers.name: Public Health Specialist
careers.description: Works with communities and evidence to prevent illness and improve health at scale.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Looks at community patterns and ways to support health.

careers.name: Genetic Counselor
careers.description: Helps people understand genetic information and consider choices with care.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds a biology or health foundation and specialist training.

careers.name: Veterinarian
careers.description: Diagnoses and treats animal health needs while advising caregivers.
careers.educationPathway: Accredited health education and supervised practice; registration rules vary by country.
careers.typicalActivities: Completes veterinary education and local professional registration.

careers.name: Secondary School Teacher
careers.description: Plans learning experiences and supports students as they build knowledge and confidence.
careers.educationPathway: Subject or counseling study plus local teacher or counselor preparation requirements.
careers.typicalActivities: Pairs subject study with teacher preparation or local qualification.

careers.name: Career Counselor
careers.description: Helps people reflect on interests and options, then plan small ways to explore.
careers.educationPathway: Subject or counseling study plus local teacher or counselor preparation requirements.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies counseling, psychology, education, or career development.

careers.name: Journalist
careers.description: Researches events and issues, checks information, and shares stories with an audience.
careers.educationPathway: Media, journalism, communications, or subject expertise with published work or a portfolio.
careers.typicalActivities: Follows a question, checks sources, and explains what evidence shows.

careers.name: Documentary Producer
careers.description: Develops factual films or audio stories through research and creative production.
careers.educationPathway: Media, journalism, communications, or subject expertise with published work or a portfolio.
careers.typicalActivities: Plans interviews and scenes to help audiences understand a real story.

careers.name: Graphic Designer
careers.description: Creates visual materials that help an audience understand or use a message.
careers.educationPathway: Design education or portfolio-led practice with projects and feedback.
careers.typicalActivities: Tries visual layouts to make a message easier to understand.

careers.name: Animator
careers.description: Creates movement and visual sequences for films, games, learning, or media.
careers.educationPathway: Design education or portfolio-led practice with projects and feedback.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds a sequence and adjusts it until the movement feels right.

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.description: Researches rules and evidence, advises clients, and helps resolve legal questions.
careers.educationPathway: Law education and professional qualification requirements vary by jurisdiction.
careers.typicalActivities: Organizes evidence and arguments to explain options under the law.

careers.name: Patent Examiner
careers.description: Reviews technical applications to see whether an invention meets patent rules.
careers.educationPathway: Public policy, law, language, technical, or subject study; national entry routes vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Pairs technical study with local patent-office requirements.

careers.name: Policy Analyst
careers.description: Studies public issues and summarizes evidence and choices for decision makers.
careers.educationPathway: Public policy, law, language, technical, or subject study; national entry routes vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies policy, economics, law, history, or a relevant subject.

careers.name: Diplomat
careers.description: Represents a country and works with people from different places on shared interests.
careers.educationPathway: Public policy, law, language, technical, or subject study; national entry routes vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Routes and selection vary by country; language skills can be useful.

careers.name: Forensic Scientist
careers.description: Applies scientific methods to examine evidence and report findings for investigations.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant science education and lab or field experience; research roles may need further study.
careers.typicalActivities: Records analysis steps so findings can be reviewed.

careers.name: Economist
careers.description: Studies how people, businesses, and governments make choices with limited resources.
careers.educationPathway: Finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, or business study; professional credentials vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Uses models and evidence to explore how policies or markets may change.

careers.name: Actuary
careers.description: Uses probability and statistics to help organizations understand long-term uncertainty.
careers.educationPathway: Finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, or business study; professional credentials vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds strong math skills and follows professional exams or training.

careers.name: Financial Analyst
careers.description: Studies financial information and explains how it could affect a business decision.
careers.educationPathway: Finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, or business study; professional credentials vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Studies finance, economics, accounting, or business and builds analysis skills.

careers.name: Entrepreneur
careers.description: Builds an idea into a service, product, or organization by testing what people need.
careers.educationPathway: Business, economics, analytics, or a related field paired with applied projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Talks with users, builds a trial, and learns whether an idea helps.

careers.name: Product Manager
careers.description: Helps teams choose what to build by connecting user needs, goals, and delivery.
careers.educationPathway: Business, economics, analytics, or a related field paired with applied projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Brings perspectives together to decide which product problem matters.

careers.name: Accountant
careers.description: Organizes and interprets financial records so people can make informed decisions.
careers.educationPathway: Finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, or business study; professional credentials vary.
careers.typicalActivities: Checks how transactions are recorded and explains a financial picture.

careers.name: Marketing Researcher
careers.description: Studies audiences and products to learn what people value or find confusing.
careers.educationPathway: Business, economics, analytics, or a related field paired with applied projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Looks across responses to find audience needs.

careers.name: Social Worker
careers.description: Supports people through difficult circumstances and connects them with resources.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant social science education; practice roles may need local credentials and supervised training.
careers.typicalActivities: Helps people navigate practical support and next steps.

careers.name: Psychologist
careers.description: Studies thoughts and behavior or supports people using evidence-informed approaches.
careers.educationPathway: Relevant social science education; practice roles may need local credentials and supervised training.
careers.typicalActivities: Uses careful questions and evidence to understand how people learn or cope.

careers.name: Supply Chain Analyst
careers.description: Studies how goods move and helps teams improve their journey to customers.
careers.educationPathway: Business, economics, analytics, or a related field paired with applied projects.
careers.typicalActivities: Maps delivery processes and spots where time or resources get stuck.

careers.name: Chef
careers.description: Plans and prepares food while coordinating timing, ingredients, and a kitchen team.
careers.educationPathway: Vocational training or apprenticeship with local safety and licensing requirements.
careers.typicalActivities: Experiments with recipes and coordinates kitchen service.

careers.name: Electrician
careers.description: Installs, inspects, and repairs electrical systems while following safety requirements.
careers.educationPathway: Vocational training or apprenticeship with local safety and licensing requirements.
careers.typicalActivities: Traces wiring problems safely and verifies repairs with measurements.

careers.name: Industrial Designer
careers.description: Designs physical products around user needs, form, materials, and manufacturing.
careers.educationPathway: Design education or portfolio-led practice with projects and feedback.
careers.typicalActivities: Builds a quick model to see whether a product feels comfortable and useful.
